findings.name: Lodestone Reversal
findings.rendered_text: Pull the target 2 tiles at Range 2 for 3 damage, leave Electrified at the destination, then gain 5 Block.
findings.behavior: The Pull moves the enemy. The ground rider uses the original aim tile.
findings.scenario: Pull an enemy from (4,4) to (3,4). Electrified appears only on (4,4).

findings.name: Ember Guard
findings.rendered_text: Gain 10 Block, then leave Fire on each enemy's tile.
findings.behavior: The effect places Fire on visible enemy footprint tiles orthogonally adjacent to you.
findings.scenario: With enemies one and three tiles away, cast the card. Only the adjacent enemy's tile gains Fire.

findings.name: Ember Ward
findings.rendered_text: Gain 5 Block, then leave Fire on each enemy's tile.
findings.behavior: The effect places Fire on visible enemy footprint tiles orthogonally adjacent to you.
findings.scenario: With enemies one and three tiles away, cast the card. Only the adjacent enemy's tile gains Fire.

findings.name: Static Ward
findings.rendered_text: Gain 5 Block, then leave Electrified on your tile and each enemy's tile.
findings.behavior: The effect places Electrified on visible enemy footprint tiles orthogonally adjacent to you and on your tile.
findings.scenario: With enemies one and three tiles away, cast the card. Only the adjacent enemy's tile gains Electrified and your tile also gains Electrified.

findings.name: Stone Ward
findings.rendered_text: Gain 5 Block, then leave Rubble on each enemy's tile.
findings.behavior: The effect places Rubble on visible enemy footprint tiles orthogonally adjacent to you.
findings.scenario: With enemies one and three tiles away, cast the card. Only the adjacent enemy's tile gains Rubble.

findings.name: Cinderweave Guard
findings.rendered_text: Gain 5 Block, then Strike for 2 and leave Fire on the target's tile.
findings.behavior: The Strike is a targetless attack on the four adjacent tiles. The same area gains Fire, including empty floor.
findings.scenario: Play between two adjacent enemies on open floor. Each loses 2 Health and all four neighboring tiles gain Fire.

findings.name: Bottled Gale
findings.rendered_text: Consume. Push the target 3 tiles.
findings.behavior: A targetless, self-centered area Pushes each adjacent enemy 3 tiles away.
findings.scenario: Play with enemies east and north of you. Both move 3 tiles and the card accepts zero target selections.

findings.name: Caltrops
findings.rendered_text:
Tile [range] 2
[consume] Consume tile. Leave [surface_rubble] Rubble and [expose] Expose 2 each enemy hit.[diagram 1]
findings.behavior: The word “tile” is part of the visible command. The card consumes the item copy and keeps the target tile, placing Rubble there.
findings.scenario: Aim at a stone tile while an enemy is in the area. The board tile stays stone with Rubble and the card enters the consumed pile.

findings.name: Powder Keg
findings.rendered_text: Place the Outcrop within Range.
findings.behavior: Placement raises a powder keg. A keg blocks movement but has `blocks_sight = false`.
findings.scenario: Place the card on any legal nearby floor tile. The resulting terrain kind is `powder_keg` and line of sight through the tile is preserved.

findings.name: Grounding
findings.rendered_text: Remove the named ground from the target's tile to use this effect.
findings.behavior: The card has no selected target for Expend. It removes eligible Electrified within 2 tiles of you, including empty tiles.
findings.scenario: Put Electrified on an empty adjacent tile and play the card. The ground is removed and you gain 6 Stoneskin.

findings.name: Spike Mantle
findings.rendered_text: Remove the named ground from the target's tile to use this effect.
findings.behavior: The card has no selected target for Expend. It removes eligible Rubble on the four adjacent tiles, including empty tiles.
findings.scenario: Put Rubble on an empty adjacent tile and play the card. The ground is removed and you gain 4 Stoneskin.

findings.name: Seek the Light
findings.rendered_text: Move to a visible open tile up to 2 tiles away, ignoring intervening tiles.
findings.behavior: The ordinary destination limit is 2. The card's alternate limit for open Light destinations is 5.
findings.scenario: Create Light on open floor five tiles away and use Seek the Light to land there.

findings.name: Sleet Squall
findings.rendered_text: Deal 3 damage to a target within Range and line of sight.
findings.behavior: Range 3 applies to the Push aim. The automatic Ranged action follows the moved enemy and does not require a new Range or sight check.
findings.scenario: Aim at an enemy three tiles away on a clear line. The enemy ends five tiles away and still takes 3 damage.

findings.name: Snare Coil

findings.name: Thunderstone

findings.name: Meteorfall
findings.rendered_text: Deal 8 damage to a target within Range and line of sight.
findings.behavior: The cast aims a center. At impact the damage uses saved Marked tiles and checks occupants without measuring fresh Range or sight.
findings.scenario: Aim at distance 4 with an enemy standing on the far end of the mark line at distance 5. The saved mark hits that enemy for 8.

findings.name: Meteorfall

findings.behavior: Range 4 is the center selection limit. The saved marks extend beyond the center.
findings.scenario: In an open corridor aim at distance 4. The three marked tiles lie at distances 3, 4 and 5.

findings.name: Meteorfall
findings.rendered_text: Mark tiles within Range and line of sight.
findings.behavior: Range and line of sight constrain center selection. The other marked tiles are taken from the area at that center.
findings.scenario: Select the legal distance-4 center. A tile at distance 5 is marked.

findings.name: Cinder Wall
findings.rendered_text: Leave Fire on 4 tiles within Range 2, then gain 4 Block. On Fire: +4 Block.
findings.behavior: The Range 2 check applies to the aim tile. The pattern can place Fire on floor farther away.
findings.scenario: Aim straight down an open corridor at distance 2. The resulting Fire occupies distances 1 through 4.

findings.name: Frost Lane
findings.rendered_text: Leave Ice on 3 tiles within Range 3, then Draw 1.
findings.behavior: The Range 3 check applies to the aim tile. The pattern can place Ice on floor farther away.
findings.scenario: Aim straight down an open corridor at distance 3. The resulting Ice occupies distances 2 through 4.

findings.name: Lamp Oil
findings.rendered_text: Consume. Leave Fire on 3 tiles within Range 3.
findings.behavior: The Range 3 check applies to the aim tile. The pattern can place Fire on floor farther away.
findings.scenario: Aim straight down an open corridor at distance 3. The resulting Fire occupies distances 2 through 4.

findings.name: Earthen Rampart
findings.rendered_text: Raise Outcrops on 3 tiles within Range 2, then gain 3 Stoneskin. Empower for Exhaust: 5 tiles.

findings.name: Grapple
findings.rendered_text: Blink to a tile adjacent to an enemy, Outcrop or crate within Range 4.
findings.behavior: The destination check accepts adjacency to any live terrain. The current game includes player-placed powder kegs.

findings.name: Jaw Trap
findings.rendered_text: Deal 2 damage at Range 3 and Immobilize.
findings.behavior: The relic increases the damage to 3 and leaves Range at 2. The inspection binder places the Range value in the damage slot and damage in the Range slot.
findings.scenario: Equip Alchemist’s Retort. Read Jaw Trap in the item detail and play it on a distance-2 crawler. The face and runtime are damage 3 and Range 2.

findings.name: Frost Circuit
findings.rendered_text: Deal 2 damage to a target within Range and line of sight.
findings.behavior: The chosen tile has Range 3. Converting a connected Ice component hits each enemy touching the converted tiles without a new Range or sight check.

borderline.reason: The generic Burst panel highlights the source plus four neighbors. The card face or sentence says the card spares you. The diagram asserts an area and no longer says you are among the direct victims. A separate keg or trap can still hit you.

Each named fuel tile supplies a Burst footprint. A unit in two footprints takes one hit for the combined area under the default rules. The current wording names each source without promising a repeated hit when footprints overlap.

Under R23, Fire is the ground term in these sentences. Fire-ground contact really does no damage while protected. A broad reading that includes a separate Burst fueled by Fire would conflict with the resolver. Candidate 4's sentences give that attack its own Burst term.

Enemy chips and enemy-first Range help describe the ordinary aim. Ranged also accepts selectable terrain or traps, and Lightning can offer a conductive aim tile. Treat the extra board targets as omissions in the short copy. The affirmative line-of-sight restriction on the two trophies is separately listed.

The Ranged 9 panel can be read as an independent sight or Range gate on the final hit. The card does require sight and Range 3 to choose its center. The two diagrams and the sentence tie the hit to that center instead of a new target selection.

The cards use “in melee.” Retaliate treats melee attacks and attacks launched from adjacent tiles as melee contact. An adjacent ranged hit can trigger it. Read “in melee” as in melee contact in the short panels, with the glossary supplying the precise test.
The Health cost is presented first and paid at commitment after the effects. The sentences use a separate cost command without “then” to specify an execution order.

“At Range N” on a patterned action conventionally describes the aim. Glacier Salts says “within Range 3” without attaching a tile count, so it can still describe where you can aim. The findings distinguish sentences that put an explicit number of affected tiles within the Range limit.

“Gain Retaliate 4 each turn” describes the effective ongoing amount. Runtime adds a persistent +4 when totaling Retaliate instead of depositing a fresh stack each turn. It is already effective the turn you play the Rite.

The diagram marks the center as a reference. The prose “within” includes the center geometrically, but an enemy at the center has no direction toward it. There is no promise to move that enemy elsewhere.
